{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify 'LOYAL' exists
assert 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique(), "'LOYAL' segment not found in data"

# Filter for LOYAL and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for any rows where revenue_clean == 999999.99 (after cleaning)
outlier_mask = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
outlier_count = outlier_mask.sum()

# Print findings
print(f"Number of LOYAL, completed orders: {len(df_loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Number of rows with cleaned revenue == 999999.99: {outlier_count}")"}
